_comment: Every SVG-2 spec entry that elm-typed-svg deliberately does NOT model, each with an exception bucket + a substantive reason. This is the honesty ledger the permanent gate (tools/check-svg-spec-coverage.mjs) enforces: for the two mechanically-diffable axes (elements, presentation properties) EVERY un-modeled spec entry MUST appear here or the gate goes red; and every entry here MUST correspond to a real spec-index.json entry (stale exceptions for a now-modeled entry also fail). `attribute` and `documentary` entries record the named-attribute and value-grammar deferrals/non-goals the plan's §1 buckets call out (xlink, zoomAndPan, path-data DSL) so they are tracked even though they are not part of the element/presentation diff. Dispositions trace to docs/svg-audit/2026-08-21-svg-coverage-audit.md §4–§6.

buckets.smil-deferred: SMIL declarative-timeline elements/attributes; distinct animation model, perennial deprecation risk in Chromium. Deferred (OQ-2). Modeled seam left for a future pass.
buckets.html-embed-legacy: audio/canvas/iframe/video in the SVG namespace were never broadly shipped; drive these from HTML instead.
buckets.raw-text-carrier: script/style carry raw text/JS — not a typed surface a code-generator can meaningfully type.
buckets.not-real: unknown is a placeholder for unrecognised elements; never authored by hand.
buckets.xlink-legacy: xlink:* is superseded by the bare href attribute (already modeled) — the SVG-2-preferred form (OQ-4).
buckets.marker-shorthand: the `marker` presentation property is a shorthand for marker-start/mid/end; the longhands are modeled instead.
buckets.path-data-non-goal: the `d` attribute is modeled as a String; a fully-typed path-command DSL is a large surface and a legitimate ergonomic loss — explicit non-goal (plan §4.6).
buckets.requiredFeatures-legacy: requiredFeatures was dropped from the SVG-2 attribute index (SVG-1.1 legacy); not part of the modeled surface.

exceptions.name: zoomAndPan
exceptions.note: Deprecated in SVG 2; deliberately not modeled (audit §6 geometry family).

exceptions.name: d (path-data grammar)
exceptions.note: The `d` attribute IS modeled (as String); a fully-typed path-command DSL is an explicit non-goal — large surface, real ergonomic loss (plan §4.6).

exceptions.name: requiredFeatures
exceptions.note: Dropped from the SVG-2 attribute index (SVG-1.1 legacy); correctly outside the modeled surface (audit §8, OQ-1).
